name: Devrak
summary: At the Crossroads, Devrak keeps the Horde’s wind riders ready for the roads across Kalimdor. The orc flight master carries couriers and supplies between Durotar, Mulgore, frontier outposts, and the Horde’s capitals.

sections.title: Keeper of the Crossroads Roosts
sections.body: At the Crossroads, Devrak tends the wind riders that link the Horde’s far-flung holdings. The outpost stands where Kalimdor’s major trade routes meet, exposed beneath the sun and vulnerable to quilboar, centaur, and Alliance scouts. Quick flights matter here. Devrak pairs seasoned travelers and new messengers with trained wind riders that cross the savannah and reach Mulgore’s mountains or Durotar’s stone canyons.

sections.title: Supplies for the Warchief and the Chieftain
sections.body: Devrak also helps move supplies from the frontier. Barrens hunters bring in meat and pelts, and he helps send them to Orgrimmar’s cooking fires and Thunder Bluff’s tanners. He introduces new couriers to flight masters across the continents, keeping an aerial route open to the Horde’s heartlands.

sections.title: A Deadly Roost
sections.body: Devrak tends more than beasts at the Crossroads. When the settlement comes under attack, he calls enraged wyverns to strike intruders with venomous stingers and talons. His roost is a dangerous target for anyone who attacks.

faq.q: What is Devrak's role at the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Devrak is the Horde flight master at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He tends the outpost’s wind riders, grants flight paths to connected settlements across Kalimdor, and coordinates the transport of couriers, soldiers, and trade goods.

aliases: where can i fly from crossroads
faq.answer: From the Crossroads, Devrak connects you to capitals such as Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff, and to frontier outposts in Ashenvale, Stonetalon Mountains, Dustwallow Marsh, Thousand Needles, and the southern frontiers. You must have spoken to those flight masters first.
Devrak helps young Horde adventurers learn the flight network by sending them with fresh meat to Gryshka in Orgrimmar and bundles of hides to Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: How does Devrak defend himself if the Crossroads is attacked?
faq.answer: If Alliance raiders or hostile beasts attack the Crossroads, Devrak can call enraged wyverns to aid him. The creatures drive attackers off with tooth and talon.

faq.q: Why is having a flight master at the Crossroads so critical?
aliases: why is crossroads flight master important
faq.answer: The Barrens is central Kalimdor’s connective spine. With the Crossroads linking Durotar, Mulgore, Ashenvale, and Stonetalon, Devrak’s roost lets the Horde move forces quickly and coordinate supplies without days of travel on foot.
Devrak handles wind riders, also called wyverns. These winged, draconic predators of Kalimdor’s peaks and mesas were befriended by the Horde as reliable flying mounts across rough terrain.

angles.text: For Horde adventurers navigating Kalimdor, Devrak is an indispensable ally and a central link between the orcs, trolls, and tauren territories.
In the dry heart of the Barrens, Devrak shows an orc’s talent for working with Kalimdor’s wind riders, bonding with the fierce beasts to secure aerial dominance.
